Browse the built-in official Claud"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"e catalog and install Claude Code and Codex plugins. | **Commands** | Markdown commands fro"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"m Claude Code plugins are converted into DSH skills so you can use their workflows. |
| **Agents** |"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" Subagent definitions become callable skills, with a delegation entry point that uses DSH's native `"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"subagent` tool. |
| **MCP** | Connect plugin-declared MCP servers, configure service addresses, auth"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"entication, headers, and environment variables, then inspect tools and control which ones are enable"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"d. |

- **Automatically discover local skills**: By default, scan `~/.ag"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ents/skills` under your home directory (`~\.agents\skills` on Windows) and show the skills in the **"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"Skills** tab without importing them individually.
- **Toggle individual local skills**: Enable or di"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"sable skills from the list or detail page.
